producing_agent.identity: Claude Fable 5 (Cursor agent, under J. Brown direction)

hypothesis: Review item 2 on 'Intention Is All You Need' v3: Theorem B's 'as D grows the cells coarsen' implies nested optima that rate-distortion does not guarantee. Registered predictions: rates (5, 3, 2, 2, 1) on the budget grid (0, 1/4, 1/2, 3/4, 1); D=0 optimum uniquely the level-set partition; all-optimizer nesting FAILS (registered witness shape: a {01}{23}{4}-type optimizer at 1/4 does not refine a {012}{34}-type optimizer at 1/2); a chosen chain of optimizers exists that does nest. The exported wording is only: the optimal rate falls.
decision: Accept nestedness_fails_generally if the rate vector is weakly decreasing and some adjacent optimizer pair fails refinement. Accept nestedness_holds_here if every adjacent optimizer pair nests. Otherwise inconclusive. chain_exists is recorded separately in every case. Any recorded verdict passes CI.

gates.NEST_SPECIFIED: World, law, budgets, predictions, verdict rule in core.py before evaluation.
gates.NEST_RATE_MONOTONE: Optimal rate weakly decreasing (feasible sets nest).
gates.NEST_D0_IS_LEVELS: D=0 optimizer set is exactly the level partition (matches DialZero.lean).
gates.NEST_CHAIN_RECORDED: all_nested and chain_exists recorded with witnesses.
gates.NEST_RANKING_RECORDED: Verdict is one of the three registered outcomes.
gates.NEST_CLAIM_BOUNDARY: One registered world; worst-case distortion; no continuous claim.

kill_criteria.NEST_ENUMERATION_COMPLETE: Kill the instrument if the enumeration is not exactly 52.
kill_criteria.NEST_RATE_MONOTONE: Kill the instrument if rates rise anywhere: that would contradict feasible-set nesting and mean the optimizer search is wrong.
kill_criteria.essay_wording: The essay's 'cells coarsen' stays withdrawn if all_nested is false; it is reinstated at this bound only if nestedness_holds_here.
kill_criteria.registered_rates: If observed rates differ from (5, 3, 2, 2, 1), record the observed vector and flag the discrepancy — the enumeration is authoritative over the registration.

audit_card.target_object: Whether rate-distortion optima nest along the budget on the registered world — the formal content behind Theorem B's withdrawn wording.
audit_card.decision: nestedness_fails_generally / nestedness_holds_here / inconclusive by the registered rule.
audit_card.representation: Five worlds, task law (0, 1/4, 1/2, 3/4, 1), worst-case within-cell law gap as distortion, rate = cell count, all 52 partitions.
audit_card.data_clock: None. Exhaustive enumeration, exact rationals, no sampling, no LLM.
material_assumptions: Distortion is the worst-case within-cell task-law gap (the essay's adequacy/weakness reading), not expected distortion.
Rate is the number of cells.
The budget grid is the registered five points.

objects.distortion: max over cells of (max law - min law) within the cell
objects.R(D): min cell count among partitions with distortion <= D
objects.refines: every cell of the finer sits inside a cell of the coarser

mathematical_claim.types_domains_units: Laws and budgets are exact rationals in [0,1]; rates are integers 1..5.
mathematical_claim.exact_claim: R over the grid (0, 1/4, 1/2, 3/4, 1) equals (5, 3, 2, 2, 1). The D=0 optimizer set is exactly {level partition}. There exist optimizers P at D=1/4 and Q at D=1/2 with not refines(P, Q). There exists a selection of one optimizer per budget forming a refinement chain.
mathematical_claim.quantifiers: Universal over all 52 partitions for each R(D); existential for the nesting failure witness and for the chain.
mathematical_claim.assumptions: Registered world, law, grid, worst-case distortion, cell-count rate.
mathematical_claim.identification_conditions: The result is identified as a property of this registered instance; the general exported claim is only rate monotonicity, which follows from feasible-set nesting.
mathematical_claim.derivation_dependencies: DialZero.lean (the D=0 clause, kernel-checked); the essay's Theorem B discussion; review item 2 in docs/intention_essay_v3_corrections.md.
mathematical_claim.coordinate_invariance: The world is a labeled chain; the law is strictly monotone, so relabeling is not quotiented here — no invariance claim is made.
mathematical_claim.edge_limiting_null_cases: At D >= 1 the single-cell partition is optimal (rate 1). If the law had ties, D=0 optima would coarsen accordingly (covered generally by DialZero.lean, not re-run here).

compute.sampling: None. 52 partitions, five budgets, exact rationals.

claim_boundary: Accepted only as: on this registered world, the optimal rate falls (5, 3, 2, 2, 1), the D=0 optimum is the level partition, all-optimizer nesting fails with an explicit witness, and a nested chain exists as a selection. The essay's 'cells coarsen' wording stays withdrawn; the exported general slogan is 'the optimal description rate falls as the budget grows'. Not a continuous claim. Not average-case. Not an LLM.
